Remove a plugin link registered with nself plugin link.

After unlinking, nself build will use the registry version again.
Unlinking an already-unlinked plugin returns success with a no-op message.

Usage:
  nself plugin unlink <name> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for unlink

Global Flags:
      --json                      Machine-readable output: one JSON document on stdout (see JSON-Output)
      --no-deprecation-warnings   Suppress deprecation warnings (for scripted use)
      --no-monorepo               Disable automatic monorepo backend detection
